info.name: Bramhkanti Storefront API
info.description:
Store API for the Bramhkanti storefront (Medusa 2.21.2 backend).

Setup: import the environment file, set `publishable_key` (Admin > Settings > Publishable API Keys > 'Bramhkanti Storefront'), then run folders top to bottom. Test scripts save ids (region_id, product_id, variant_id, cart_id, payment_collection_id, order_id) into the environment automatically.

Money: amounts are rupees (major unit) and GST-inclusive, except Razorpay session `data.amount`, which is paise.

Full guide: STOREFRONT_INTEGRATION.md
